statement: In 3 of 5 books an adult makes the resolution possible (a tickle, a distracted injection, a 'yes'); in the other 2 the child resolves it (a plan and a catch; leaving Mud in the bath).

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2024)

magicpaper.current: MagicPaper beats favour the child acting (take_charge, find_own_courage)
magicpaper.suggested: No change; record that adult-enabled endings are common in this population, and track agency as the corpus grows.
